# Bid the rails, the stairs, and the coats.

> Price a deck stain or seal from walking surface, picket-rail lineal feet, stairs, prep, coats, and access — not a published $2.50-per-square-foot special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
